messages:
Jordan (AE): FYI OrchidLabs wants to reopen renewal pricing. They say usage spiked due to a new integrator and want to move from hosted -> dedicated in Q2. Asking for a blended rate ~ $0.0036/token if we convert the POC consumption into commit credits.

Priya (CSM): They've requested a 45-day POC extension (embeddings + semantic search) and want us to guarantee data residency in eu-west-1. Security also asked for our third-party subprocessors list.

Luis (SalesOps): Our standard list: 3M commit = $0.0045/token, 6M commit = $0.0038/token. Requesting $0.0036 is ~20%+ off the 3M list. Anything >20% needs Deal Desk sign-off. Recommend structuring as: 12-mo term, 6M commit, tiered overage, and an onboarding credit to smooth cashflow.

Sam (Legal): Any contract tweak besides price? They want a 99.95% p99 latency SLA for search queries and explicit data deletion certification for EU data. That data deletion attestation will need PO and Security to confirm process. If they want amendments to indemnity or audit language, that escalates.

Reza (Eng): Dedicated pool for search + embeddings can meet 99.95% p99 but we need to size for peak QPS. Estimation: 8 GPUs reserved, 10 business days to provision and test. For POC extension we should restrict model choice to our quantized variant to control cost.

Jordan (AE): They proposed converting 90 days of POC spend (~$30k) into committed credits and then the remainder split as a discount. Asking for a clause that lets them reduce commit by 15% at renewal if usage drops. Thoughts?

Luis (SalesOps): Numeric proposal to include in Deal Desk request:
```
Commit: 6M tokens/month (12 months)
Rate: $0.0037/token (blended for year 1)
Onboarding credit: $25,000 applied month 1
POC conversion: roll $30k POC spend into month 1 credits
Early annual exit: allowed once with 15% fee if commit reduced >15%
```
This keeps effective rate near asked level but limits long-term revenue leakage.

Priya (CSM): I'll gather the customer's expected QPS and payload sizes. Also got a checklist from them for logging/trace retention and export formats.

Sam (Legal): Please upload the subprocessors list + data deletion runbook to the legal queue. If they require contract language changes for deletion attestation, add that to the escalation.

Reza (Eng): Recommend adding a performance fallback: if dedicated SLO not met, auto-failover to hosted with a 10% credit applied that billing period. We can instrument with an alert to trigger the failover.

Jordan (AE): OK I'm going to file Deal Desk Request now with Luis' numbers and include the POC conversion math. Targeting internal review by EOD Monday to hit Orchids' renewal window.

quota-bot: DealDeskRequest created: DD-2026-8812 (status: queued)

Luis (SalesOps): Heads-up: approvals required = AE, Head of Sales, Finance. If Legal flags data residency language we may need Security sign-off too. I'll draft justification and attach the numbers.

Priya (CSM): Customer asks for contract signed by May 2. I'll schedule a joint call with Security & Eng if Legal needs it.

Jordan (AE): Great. If Deal Desk pushes back on rate, fallback plan: 9-month ramp with a mid-year true-up and lower onboarding credit. I'll keep the team posted. :eyes:
